prompt: Elements `[18, 14, 22, 9, 7, 31, 45]` are placed into an array and converted into a Min-Heap using Floyd's bottom-up buildHeap algorithm. Which array representation satisfies the min-heap parent-child invariant `A[i] <= A[2i+1]` and `A[i] <= A[2i+2]`?
explanation: A valid binary min-heap must satisfy A[i] <= children for every parent. Bottom-up heapify rearranges `[18, 14, 22, 9, 7, 31, 45]` to `[7, 9, 22, 18, 14, 31, 45]`.
